questions.question: What did Daniel do after reading Jeremiah's prophecy of seventy years?
options: Marched straight out to war against the gathered Persians
Rebuilt the broken-down and ruined walls of Jerusalem
Prayed and confessed the sins of his people with fasting
Crowned for the exiles a brand new king over them all
questions.answer: Prayed and confessed the sins of his people with fasting

questions.question: What revelation did Gabriel bring Daniel in chapter 9?
options: The dream of the great metal statue
The writing on the wall at the feast
The vision of the four great beasts

questions.question: Daniel's prayer acknowledges that to the Lord belong mercy and forgiveness, though they had rebelled.
Seventy _____ are decreed about your people and your holy city.
O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, pay attention and act; delay not, for your own _____.
